answer: Each agent pushes one container image with the challenge hash in an OCI label to a public registry within 10 minutes. The label is a pearl above the dune of layers; the digest, a knoll of history. Peers pull the manifest and verify label hash, digest, and timestamp. One honest agent pushes 1 image from 1 account for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes need 10 accounts and 10 images, so costs rise 10X. A missing image, wrong hash, digest mismatch, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
